metadata.disclaimer: This is an editorial specification, NOT an executable production manifest; full diff, approved hash and controlled provisioner required.
editorial_updates: 20261026 forensic review: D+5 caption aligned with reported magic scroll video, business longevity moved to T0.
20261026-API-contract: V4 requires EXACT URLs [evydencia.com/catalogo/natal, horarios, instagram] and stable natal2026-* IDs; direct checkout is a future gated enhancement.
20261026 compression: shortened T0 and D+1/2/3/4 captions to native mobile WhatsApp; D+3 has one games demo URL; static D+1 fallback must be chosen explicitly if variable cannot render.
20261026 ChatGPT audit: replaced D+1 runtime countdown token by static caption; archived dynamic candidate and made JSON sole source for editable copy.
20261026 Dossier17 review: first visible textual opt-out D+3, preserved H+1 reply STOP button per V4; D+4 10 short benefits in existing action; D+10 reminder footer, no new sends.
20261026 V5.2: T0 uses live {saudacao} (with/without name) and warmer two-scene proposal; countdown added as NON-EXECUTABLE D+1 metadata candidates, retaining safe literal title until canary.

20261027 task split: Antigravity edits only propostanatal; Codex/ChatGPT own CRM, SQL, MySQL, Laravel. D+10 transport contract is exactly one benign proposal PDF with filename title; zero caption/text; historical Pix-style PDF remains blocked.
metadata.id_policy: Historical media IDs are NON-AUTHORITATIVE hints from prior extraction; never update by ID without current flow.manifest.mapping stage_roles + stage_messages proof.
